cases.name: Transferable tool
cases.prompt: Posting requires Tableau and stakeholder demos. Resume says Power BI dashboards and quarterly demos to operations managers.
expectations: Maps Power BI to transferable visualization experience.
Rewrites at least one bullet using only dashboards and the documented demos.

cases.name: Missing base
cases.prompt: Here is a posting requiring vendor onboarding, French and contract negotiation. Build my tailored resume. I have supplied no work history.
expectations: Requests relevant base resume or experience examples.
Leaves language fluency and negotiation experience unresolved.
Avoids drafting a fabricated employment history.

cases.name: Two variants
cases.prompt: My base lists inventory reconciliation and scheduling. Produce one version for stock control and one for shift planning. The postings name only those respective duties.
expectations: Labels the two distinct target variants.
Prioritizes inventory reconciliation in the stock-control version.
Prioritizes scheduling in the shift-planning version.
Keeps the factual base consistent and does not invent team or stock counts.
